throughput.source_quote: Total crude oil and feedstocks throughput (millions of barrels) 165.3 [Year Ended December 31, 2013]

notional_positions.notes: Crude oil and feedstock purchase obligation derivatives designated as fair value hedges (inventory supply arrangement). Long purchase commitments.
Intermediates and refined products purchase obligation derivatives designated as fair value hedges (Inventory Intermediation Agreement, commenced July 2013).
Crude oil economic hedges (not designated). Used to manage price volatility in crude inventory and purchase/sale transactions. Direction not specified; assumed net short for inventory hedging.

warnings: PBF does not disclose gross long/short positions for economic hedges. Fair value hedge volumes are purchase obligation contracts. Economic hedge direction assumed net short for inventory hedging. Fair values in thousands: FVH crude supply ($177K) liability + intermediation $6,016K asset; economic ($19,421K) liability.
